credits.title: Drummer Boy
credits.overview: As America’s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family search for freedom. Through battle and loss, music carries hope in a deeply human story of faith and forgiveness.

credits.title: A Gangster's Life
credits.overview: When two low-level criminals scam a vicious London mob and are in over their heads, they flee to rural Greece to avoid the bloody repercussions. But escape isn't that simple.

credits.title: Love on the Danube: Kissing Stars
credits.overview: Publicist Savannah Bailey offers Tripp Marks, her actor client of newfound fame, the ability to connect with fans and find his type at a rom com cruise event Kiss con after reinventing himself but he must learn who he is without celebrity.

credits.title: Christmas on Mistletoe Farm
credits.overview: After inheriting a farm at Christmas time, a widowed father makes a bumpy adjustment to village life — while his kids hatch a plan to stay there forever.

credits.title: The People We Hate at the Wedding
credits.overview: A dysfunctional family that can't seem to get along and get it together reluctantly reunites for a family wedding. As their many skeletons are wrenched from the closet, it turns out to be just what this singular family needs to reconnect.

credits.title: Middle East Side Story
credits.overview: Wouldn't it be brilliant if 'West Side Story' was set in the Middle East? No, of course not. But Ms. Reynolds thinks it would.
